2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on anticipatory bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 33 of 2023, under sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 406 and 120-B of IPC P.S.- S.I.T., District- Lucknow.
3. The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the instant matter due to ulterior motive.
He submits that the firm in question is registered under the name of applicant though admittedly he is looking after day to day functioning of the firm.

He submits that the applicant has supplied all the materials as per the supply order and due to certain misconception the amount of Rs.17.51 crores are said to be embezzled though there is no ample evidence against the applicant.
He also stated that the other co-accused persons have already been enlarged on anticipatory bail by Co-ordinate Bench of Hon'ble High Court at Allahabad.
Further submitted that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is cooperating in the investigation proceedings.
He also submits that there is apprehension that the applicant will be arrested by the police thus, submission is that the the applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the complainant has opposed the contentions aforesaid and submits that the applicant is involved in committing the aforesaid offence, as such, he is not entitled to be released on anticipatory bail.
5. Learned AGA appearing for the State has also supported the contentions of the learned counsel for the complainant.

sentences.text: Let notice be issued to opposite party no. 2, returnable at an early date.
Steps be taken within a week.
If steps are taken, office shall proceed accordingly.
List/put up this matter in third week of March, 2025.
In the meantime, the State as well as opposite party no. 2 may file their counter affidavits.

"
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been released on interim anticipatory bail after filing of the personal bonds and two sureties before the investigating officer.
He has duly cooperated in the investigation.
He has not misused the liberty of interim anticipatory bail granted by this Court.
He has no previous criminal history.
He undertakes to further cooperate in the investigation as well as in the trial andin case, he is enlarged on anticipatory bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of same.
Learned A.G.A.opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not dispute the aforesaid facts as argued by the learned counsel for the applicant.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and considering the nature of accusation and having no previous criminal antecedents, coupled with the undertaking given by the applicant that he will further cooperate in the investigation as well as in the trial, the interim protection granted by a coordinate bench of this Court vide order dated 24.02.2025 is made absolute.
In view of the aforesaid, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.
